highlights: Docking canvas for terminal panes with strict tiling: drag, dock, snap, swap, and split-resize
Multiple projects open simultaneously with detachable multi-monitor workspace windows
Count-based workspace setup wizard (Start / Layout / Agents)
fixes: Eliminate the release-build bug where PARALITH opened external console windows (occasionally dozens) that led to freezes: all background helper processes now spawn hidden via CREATE_NO_WINDOW
Prevent duplicate or orphaned terminal processes through an atomic per-pane creation reservation and per-workspace restore serialization
Guard superseded workspace hydration so rapid switching can no longer spawn terminals for a screen that is no longer displayed
databaseChanges: No schema changes; the database remains at additive schema 11
knownIssues: Production update publication remains disabled until administrators provision the updater signing key and internal HTTPS endpoint
